summary: Wrote Lab 4 (seq2seq with attention, 7 steps incl. optional packing-bug cell) and Lab 5 (diagonal linear recurrence vs RNN/LSTM, 5 steps) in src/en/module_04/21-labs-b.md. Both run cleanly with labrun --update; outputs and prose agree; only timing lines differ between reruns. Measured runtimes here: Lab 4 about 2.2 min (QUICK flag present), Lab 5 about 1.5 min. check.mjs reports no errors in 21-labs-b.md (remaining errors are in 20-labs-a.md, not mine).
changes: Lab 4 results differ from the plan: sequence accuracy without attention is 99.2/35.6/0.8% at lengths 4/8/12 (plan 100/62/2); teacher-forced token accuracy 99.8/90.6/73.0 and free-running 99.7/78.2/51.1 (plan 100/95/79 and 100/88/59); beam k=4 gives 0/200 correct strings vs greedy 0/200 (token accuracy 51.8% vs 52.5%); alignment peaks 0.65-0.83 on digit rows, EOS row peak 0.25 (plan 0.56-0.94). Unpacked-encoder cell: 100% padded, 0% cut to 4; packed 100%/100%. Parameter counts 66,381/104,973 confirmed.

Lab 5: |lambda| range 0.902329-0.998724 and half-lives 6.7-542.8 confirmed. Loop vs FFT max error is 3.6e-6, 1.4e-5, 1.5e-5 (plan said about 2e-6). CPU timings: FFT is only 1.1-5x faster than the loop (loop 1.3-2.4/5.4/22 ms, FFT 0.5/2.5/16-20 ms), not the plan's 4.9/18.9/80.8 vs 1.8/5.5/25; the lab states the FFT advantage is modest on CPU and shrinks with T.

Lab 5 recall (seed 0): vanilla RNN 63.3% at lag 25 and 75.1% at lag 100 (plan: 100% at 25, chance at 100); LSTM fb1 chance everywhere; LSTM fb5 100% at 25 (74 updates), chance at 100 and 200; diagonal linear 100% at all lags (solved at 124, 238, never under the 0.05 loss criterion at 200). Seeds 1 and 2 were also run: RNN 73/87% at 25, 11/48% at 100; fb5 100% at 25 (75, 56 updates), lag 100 100% on seed 1 and 11% on seed 2; linear 100% everywhere, lag 200 solved at 292 on seed 2. The lab prose states these ranges.
issues: Concept text in 12-concepts-c.md (s10, s11, s13) and 11-concepts-b.md (s5 'What the labs show') quotes the plan's numbers, which the real runs do not reproduce: s10 exposure bias paragraph (95% vs 88%, 79% vs 59%), s10 beam search (2% to 3%), s10 bottleneck (100/62/2%), s11 alignment (peaks 0.56-0.94; 100/62/2%), fig-04-18 caption (bars 100,62,2), s13 timings (4.9/1.8, 18.9/5.5, 80.8/25 ms), s13 'What Lab 5 shows' (agree to 2e-6; vanilla RNN solves lag 25; LSTM fb5 lag 100 'on one seed of two' ), and half-life/ring numbers are fine. Those passages should be updated to: 99/36/1% sequence accuracy; 91 vs 78 and 73 vs 51 token accuracy at lengths 8 and 12; beam 0 correct strings (token accuracy 51.8 vs 52.5); anti-diagonal peaks 0.65-0.83; FFT only modestly faster on CPU.

Lab 4 optional packing-bug cell trains two extra attention models for 800 steps (about 50 s), so Lab 4 total is about 2.2 min on this shared machine; the lab text says nothing about runtime, the build injects it.
